'''Arthon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
It was originally colonized by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], but they did not maintain control of the planet. Just prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], it was believed [[The Flail]] was going to launch an operation on Arthon.
